sectorSummary.overview: Growth was broad but the outlook was mixed across the 24 available calls: 23 companies reported positive year-on-year growth in their headline revenue, volume or AUM metric, while Aegis Logistics reported lower revenue despite distribution-volume growth. Several managements raised targets, but input costs, launch timing and working capital make the next two quarters important for delivery.

trends.text: Headline revenue, volume or AUM grew year on year in 23 of the 24 available calls.

tailwinds.text: Capacity additions, new facilities or a larger order book supported management's growth plans, although several projects are still ramping.

opportunities.text: Optical connectivity and liquid-cooling equipment are separate expansion opportunities for Sterlite and Aeroflex; neither should be treated as booked sector-wide revenue.
OnEMI and Acutaas raised FY27 growth targets after stronger operating momentum.

risks.text: Input-cost pressure or delayed execution reduced Q2 margins or shifted revenue, leaving some FY27 plans dependent on H2 recovery.
MPS's FY28 target depends partly on an unclosed acquisition; Aegis's proposed Tristar acquisition also has closing and financing conditions.

insights.text: Sterlite reported a 24% H1 optical-connectivity attach rate after targeting more than 20% from Q2, but did not disclose a standalone Q2 figure.
Aegis was the headline-growth exception: revenue declined year on year while distribution volume rose.
